The FT64E0A5-TRB is an enhanced 8-bit RISC microcontroller from Fremont Micro Devices (FMD), designed for cost-sensitive embedded applications requiring integrated analog, timing, PWM, communication, and control peripherals.

The device features up to 20 I/O pins, a 12-bit ADC, multiple PWM channels, SPI, I²C, and two USART interfaces, as well as an integrated operational amplifier. It supports operating voltages from approximately 1.9 V to 5.5 V and is housed in a compact TSSOP-20 package.
The FT64E0Ax family documentation specifies a 5.5 V maximum VDD and supports up to 20-pin versions; the FT64E0A5 is available in TSSOP-20.
ADC clock up to 2 MHz for the specified 12-bit accuracy

The integrated timers include a 16-bit Watchdog Timer, 16-bit Timer1, 16-bit Timer2, and 8-bit Timer4.
The FT64E0A5 integrates several serial communication peripherals:
This allows the device to interface with sensors, displays, EEPROMs, motor-control peripherals, communication modules, and other digital devices.

The FT64E0A5 can operate from a wide supply range suitable for both low-voltage and 5 V embedded systems.

blocks.text: RS232 to TTL Serial Interface Module With DB9 Connector

This RS232 to TTL Serial Interface Module is a board with the MAX3232 transceiver integrated circuit (IC). It facilitates serial communication between TTL and RS232 ports by providing the necessary electrical signal conversion.

These boards usually have a DB9 connector soldered at one end, and four header pins for jumper cables at the other end. The jumper cables enable the user to connect the wires to a breadboard or a microcontroller project board, whilst the DB9 connects directly to a COM port of a computer.

The MAX3232 IC, which comes in a 16 pin narrow SO package. It requires between 3.0 V to 5.5 V to operate and has two receivers and two transmitters. It has a maximum guaranteed data rate of 120 kbps, and the circuitry requires four 0.1µF charge-pump support capacitors. It is also compatible with the famous MAX3232 IC pins. These boards connect to systems with a UART hence, they work with ATMEL and PIC microcontrollers.

A quartz crystal provides both series and parallel resonance. The series resonance is a few kilohertz lower than the parallel one. Crystals below 30 MHz are generally operated between series and parallel resonance, which means that the crystal appears as an inductive reactance in operation, this inductance forming a parallel resonant circuit with externally connected parallel capacitance. Any small additional capacitance in parallel with the crystal will thus pull the frequency downwards. Moreover, the effective inductive reactance of the crystal can be reduced by adding a capacitor in series with the crystal. This latter technique can provide a useful method of trimming the oscillatory frequency within a narrow range; in this case inserting a capacitor in series with the crystal will raise the frequency of oscillation. For a crystal to operate at its specified frequency, the electronic circuit has to be exactly that specified by the crystal manufacturer. Note that these points imply a subtlety concerning crystal oscillators in this frequency range: the crystal does not usually oscillate at precisely either of its resonant frequencies.

Crystals above 30 MHz (up to >200 MHz) are generally operated at series resonance where the impedance appears at its minimum and equal to the series resistance. For these crystals the series resistance is specified (<100 Ω) instead of the parallel capacitance. To reach higher frequencies, a crystal can be made to vibrate at one of its overtone modes, which occur near multiples of the fundamental resonant frequency. Only odd numbered overtones are used. Such a crystal is referred to as a 3rd, 5th, or even 7th overtone crystal. To accomplish this, the oscillator circuit usually includes additional LC circuits to select the desired overtone.

The ULN2003 is a monolithic IC consists of seven NPN darlington transistor pairs with high voltage and current capability. It is commonly used for applications such as relay drivers, motor, display drivers, led lamp drivers, logic buffers, line drivers, hammer drivers and other high voltage current applications. It consists of common cathode clamp diodes for each NPN darlington pair which makes this driver IC useful for switching inductive loads.
Schematic Diagram of each Darlington Pair – ULN2003

The output of the driver is open collector and the collector current rating of each darlington pair is 500mA. Darlington pairs may be paralleled if higher current is required. The driver IC also consists of a 2.7KΩ base resistor for each darlington pair. Thus each darlington pair can be operated directly with TTL or 5V CMOS devices. This driver IC can be used for high voltage applications up to 50V.

Note that the driver provides open collector output, so it can only sink current, cannot source. Thus when a 5V is given to 1B terminal, 1C terminal will be connected to ground via darlington pair and the maximum current that it can handle is 500A. From the above logic diagram we can see that cathode of protection diodes are shorted to 9th pin called COM. So for driving inductive loads, it must connected to the supply voltage. Datasheet

The AD623 is an integrated, single- or dual-supply instrumentation amplifier that delivers rail-to-rail output swing using supply voltages from 3 V to 12 V. The AD623 offers superior user flexibility by allowing single gain set resistor programming and by conforming to the 8-lead industry standard pinout configuration. With no external resistor, the AD623 is configured for unity gain (G = 1), and with an external resistor, the AD623 can be programmed for gains of up to 1000.

The superior accuracy of the AD623 is the result of increasing ac common-mode rejection ratio (CMRR) coincident with increasing gain; line noise harmonics are rejected due to constant CMRR up to 200 Hz. The AD623 has a wide input common-mode range and amplifies signals with commonmode voltages as low as 150 mV below ground. The AD623 maintains superior performance with dual and single polarity power supplies.

All controls dial, buttons, input ports are positioned so the user can operate the meter in a workshop environment, often with gloves or in constrained space. The display also includes a bar-graph style analog representation in addition to numeric readings, giving instant sense of changes or instability in the measured signal.

This multimeter doesn’t just give basic voltage or current readings; it is built to manage a wide variety of tasks. The device accommodates both DC and AC measurements across multiple ranges, as well as resistance, capacitance, frequency, temperature, and more. It is suited to handling both small, precise components and higher-power circuits without constantly switching to different tools. Despite its capabilities, it maintains clarity: readouts are easy to see, the interface gives prompt response, and modes are switched without overly complex menus.

Physically, the UT61C is fairly large and sturdy. It uses a 9 V battery, which gives it portability, though its weight and size make it more comfortable when placed on a bench or mounted using its stand rather than held constantly. It also includes input protection and safety ratings, which increase confidence for users working on higher voltages. Overall, the design is about balancing versatility, precision, and durability. Whether used in lab, field, industrial maintenance or workshop, it aims to be a reliable, “do-everything” meter rather than a narrow specialty tool.

blocks.text: MCP3008 8-Channel 10-Bit A/D Converter with SPI Interface IC DIP-16 Package

The Microchip Technology Inc. MCP3008 devices are successive approximation 10-bit Analogto-Digital (A/D) converters with on-board sample and hold circuitry. The MCP3008 is programmable to provide four pseudo-differential input pairs or eight single-ended inputs. Differential Non linearity (DNL) and Integral Non linearity (INL) are specified at ±1 LSB. Communication with the devices is accomplished using a simple serial interface compatible with the SPI protocol.

The devices are capable of conversion rates of up to 200 ksps. The MCP3008 devices operate over a broad voltage range (2.7V – 5.5V). Low-current design permits operation with typical standby currents of only 5 nA and typical active currents of 320 µA. The MCP3008 is offered in 16- pin PDIP and SOIC packages.

Idle mode halts the CPU while allowing the RAM, timers, serial port, and interrupt system to remain active. Power Down mode preserves RAM contents but stops the oscillator, reducing power to a minimal level. يعتمد المعجون على مزيج من جزيئات اللحام مع مادة مساعدة على اللحام لتحسين الالتصاق، الانتشار، وتكوين نقطة لحام جيدة على أطراف المكونات ومسارات اللوحة. لذلك يعتبر مناسبًا لأعمال الصيانة التي تشمل نقاط لحام صغيرة، تبديل مكونات دقيقة، تجهيز أطراف اللحام، أو العمل على مناطق إصلاح محددة داخل اللوحة.

يمكن استخدامه في إعادة تجهيز كرات اللحام للمكونات الدقيقة باستخدام القوالب المناسبة، وصيانة المكونات السطحية، وتلميع وتجهيز نقاط اللحام، واستبدال المكونات الصغيرة، وأعمال إصلاح لوحات الهواتف والإلكترونيات. كما يساعد في الحصول على توصيل جيد، مقاومة أفضل للأكسدة، بقايا أقل بعد اللحام، ونقاط لحام أكثر انتظامًا عند استخدامه بطريقة صحيحة ومع درجة حرارة مناسبة.
العبوة بتصميم ريد سكل الأحمر عملية وسهلة التخزين على ترابيزة الصيانة، وتناسب الفنيين الذين يستخدمون محطات الهواء الساخن، كاويات اللحام، أدوات الإصلاح الدقيقة، وقوالب اللحام في أعمال الصيانة اليومية.
درجة انصهار ١٨٣ درجة: مناسبة لأعمال إصلاح الإلكترونيات واللحام الحراري المتحكم فيه.
كمية ٥٠ جرام: حجم عملي للاستخدام في الورش ومراكز الصيانة والاستخدام المتكرر.
مناسب لإعادة تجهيز كرات اللحام: يمكن استخدامه مع القوالب المناسبة في أعمال المكونات الدقيقة.
توصيل جيد: يساعد على تكوين نقاط لحام موصلة وموثوقة عند الاستخدام الصحيح.
تقليل اللحام الضعيف: يدعم التصاقًا أفضل ونتائج أكثر ثباتًا أثناء الإصلاح.
بقايا أقل: يساعد على تقليل آثار ما بعد اللحام مقارنة بالمواد كثيرة البقايا.
مقاومة للأكسدة: يدعم انتشار اللحام بشكل أفضل وتكوين نقطة لحام أنظف.
أقل عرضة للتشقق: يساعد على تكوين نقاط لحام أكثر تماسكًا عند الالتزام بدرجة الحرارة المناسبة.

Data logging is extensive: up to 100 manual saves and 10 000 logging points can be recorded at user-set intervals (1 s to 30 min). This compact and reliable vibration sensor module is designed to detect movement, tilting, or shaking and output a clean digital signal for your microcontroller . Inside, it uses a ball‑rolling type of sensor (not mercury‑based) that triggers a switch when it moves — perfect for a wide range of alarm, automation, and robotics applications .

A built‑in LM393 comparator ensures stable output, and the module comes with both a power LED and a status LED for easy visual feedback . An onboard potentiometer lets you adjust the trigger sensitivity to suit your needs .

blocks.text: When the module is not vibrating, the internal switch is open, the output is HIGH, and the green indicator LED is OFF .
When a vibration or tilt occurs, the switch momentarily closes, the output goes LOW, and the green LED lights up .
You can connect the DO pin directly to a microcontroller to detect these level changes and trigger an alarm, a notification, or any other action .

blocks.text: An Axial Lead Type Inductor is a type of passive electronic component that stores energy in a magnetic field when current flows through it. The “axial” refers to the lead configuration, where the leads extend from either end of the inductor, allowing for easy integration into circuits, especially on a breadboard or PCB (printed circuit board).

Inductors are an integral part of any electronic circuit as they help us to protect the circuit from the current surges that might happen of you start any high-power device and other RF interference in the circuit. But the inductors that come in different size and shapes like toroidal shaped, iron core, laminated core etc. For PCB application you need a small size inductor package that can be easily mounted to the PCB board like SMD package or this 1/2W Inductors for Through Hole Package that you can use simply as you use a resistor. You don’t have to worry about the big packaging size of the inductor and space on the PCB. They have color bands on them to read its inductance value. They do not have any polarity so that you can use them in any orientation. They can be easily used in filter applications, and in DC-DC converters etc..
An axial inductor provides inductance for small, low-power, low-current electronics projects. It is very similar in form factor with a resistor, but is usually colored green.

The MBR3045PT is a Schottky barrier rectifier array containing two diodes in a common‑cathode configuration, packaged in a TO‑247 (also known as TO‑3P) through‑hole package. Schottky technology provides a low forward voltage drop (0.60V typical at 20A, 125°C) and virtually no reverse recovery time, making it ideal for high‑frequency switching applications where efficiency is paramount.

The device features a guard ring for over‑voltage protection, enhancing ruggedness against transient spikes. Its metal‑silicon junction ensures majority carrier conduction, eliminating minority carrier storage effects. With a non‑repetitive surge current rating of 200A (8.3ms single half‑sine wave), it can survive severe startup or fault conditions. The TO‑247 package offers low thermal resistance (1.4°C/W junction‑to‑case) and is designed for easy heatsink mounting, enabling reliable operation up to 150°C junction temperature. Typical applications include output rectification in SMPS, freewheeling diodes in motor drives, and reverse battery protection in automotive and industrial systems.

makers-391080.summary: ULN2204A-2B is a compact AM/FM radio system IC providing complete superheterodyne AM and IF/FM functions with built‑in audio amplifier in a 16‑pin PDIP.

blocks.text: ULN2204A-2B AM/FM Radio System IC PDIP-16

Providing all radio functions except VHF tuning, the ULN2204A AM/FM radio system excels in low-cost applications requiring a minimal parts count and high performance. In the AM mode of operation, the device is a complete single conversion superheterodyne broadcast or shortwave receiver with AGC and peak envelope detection. In the FM mode, the ULN2204A operates as a high-gain IF amplifier/limiter and phase-shift detector. A simple dc switch is used to change the mode of operation.

A single external capacitor at pin 16 provides the AM-AGC time constant, the FM-AFC time constant, and RF decoupling. A single resistor al the same pin will adjust the AM gain for optimal system performance. The audio amplifier will work into any speaker load of 8Ω or greater. Class-B operation of the audio power amplifier yields high efficiency at the rated output with a very low quiescent power drain. The amplifier exhibits little crossover distortion. Its output impedance is significantly less than 1Ω.

The ULN2204A will work with a wide range of supply voltages and is suitable for use in AC-powered table radios and battery-powered (6V or 9V) portable radios. This system will operate at supply voltages as low as 2V at reduced volume without a significant increase in distortion. Brown-outs or weak batteries need no longer be a major concern. The ULN2204A is supplied in a 16-pin dual in-line plastic package with a copper lead frame that eliminates many decoupling problems and allows maximum power dissipation.

blocks.text: INA219 DC Current Measurement Sensor Module

The INA219 DC Current Measurement Sensor Module is a high-accuracy current sensing module designed for monitoring DC voltage, current, and power in embedded and electronic systems. Based on the Texas Instruments INA219 current/power monitor IC, it communicates through the I²C interface, making it easy to integrate with Arduino, Raspberry Pi, ESP32, STM32, and other microcontroller platforms. The module measures the voltage drop across a precision shunt resistor to accurately calculate load current while also monitoring the supply bus voltage.

The module features a programmable-gain amplifier (PGA) and a high-resolution 12-bit ADC, allowing precise measurements across a wide range of currents and voltages. It is widely used in battery-powered devices, solar energy systems, power supplies, IoT devices, robotics, and energy monitoring applications. The INA219 can simultaneously measure bus voltage and shunt voltage, enabling direct power calculation without additional components.

microohm-75.summary: Light Sensitive LDR Relay Module 12V automatically switches devices based on light levels, using an LDR sensor and relay for automation in various applications.

blocks.text: This is a self-contained switching module that energizes / de-energizes a relay based on the the detection of visible light. Just add 12V power and hook up the load you want to control then adjust the potentiometer to set the brightness level at which you want the relay to switch between ON / OFF.

The Light Sensitive LDR Relay Module 12V can automatically control a load such as a night security light based on the ambient light level. The LDR sensor is attached to a 10″ lead for remote mounting. The lead can be spliced to increase its length if desired.
Automatically controls the relay based on light intensity
Included LDR (Light Dependent Resistor) sensor on 10″ lead detects visible light
Both NO (Normally Open) and NC (Normally Closed) contacts
LED indicator when relay is energized
The light sensor on the module is a light sensitive resistor (LDR) .
The brightness level trip-point for triggering the relay can be adjusted using the potentiometer on the module. Turning the pot CW increases the brightness trip-point.
When the brightness goes below the trip-point value, an LM393 voltage comparator IC energizes the relay and it switches ON. A blue LED is illuminated when the relay is energized.
When the brightness increases above the preset value, the relay switches back OFF.

The relay has both NO (Normally Open) and NC (Normally Closed) contacts so the module can either be used to energize a load when brightness goes up past the trip-point value or when it goes down below that level.

A flyback diode is included on the module in parallel to the relay coil to safely shunt current when the relay coil is de-energized. The module also has a reverse polarity protection diode on the 12V power input.

The module requires 12V power and ground to operate. There is a red LED that is lit when power is applied to the module. When the relay is de-energized it draws approximately 10mA. When energized, the module draws about 40mA from the Vcc pin.
GND = Connect to ground of the 12V power supply
The output of the relay is rated to switch up to 30VDC at 10A or up to 250VAC at up to 10A (See our notes below).

The output is SPDT type with both a NO (Normally Open) terminal and a NC (Normally Closed) terminal relative to the COM terminal. When the relay is de-energized (blue LED OFF) the NO-COM connection is open and the NC-COM connection is shorted. When the relay is energized (blue LED ON) the NO – COM connection is shorted and the NC-COM connection is open.
Top = Normally Open relay contact – Load is connected to this terminal if it should switch ON when relay is energized.
Center = Common connection – Connects to AC or DC power source for load that is being controlled.
Bottom = Normally Closed relay contact – Load is connected to this terminal if it should switch ON when relay is de-energized.

These are nice inexpensive modules that will work for many applications and allow you to control devices based on sensing light without the need to have an MCU involved. Just hook up 12V power and your load and you are all set.

The sensing works over a fairly wide range of light intensities. The potentiometer provides a relative rather than absolute setting, so setting the trip point will require some amount of trial and error. Positioning of the light sensor will also have an effect on the setting.
We do find the DC rating of the relay to be too aggressive. With DC voltages above about 15V, the contacts can become a little sticky. We recommend using it to switch DC voltages of no more than 15V.
With AC, the relays performed well in our testing. To test the upper limit we used it to switch a 1500W heater that draws about 12.5A and the relay handled it without any problems.

To test the device, connect it to 12V. While pointing the LDR sensor towards a light source, adjust the pot so that the blue LED just goes off. Shielding the LDR from the light should then cause the blue LED to turn on and an audible click heard from the relay as it switches.

blocks.text: Looking to cool down your DIY project or any electronic device then you are at the right product. The TEC1-12710 40x40mm Thermoelectric Cooler 10A Peltier Module is the simple application of the Peltier Thermoelectric Effect. The module features 127 semiconductor couples in the area of 40 x 40mm which very effectively cools and heats up to 67°C. The TEC1-12710 40x40mm Thermoelectric Cooler 10.5A Peltier Module is the simple application of the Peltier Thermoelectric Effect.

Thermoelectric coolers also are known as TEC or Peltier Module create a temperature differential on each side. One side gets hot and the other side gets cool. Therefore, they can be used to either warm something up or cool something down, depending on which side you use. You can also take advantage of a temperature differential to generate electricity.

This Peltier works very well as long as you remove the heat from the hot side. After turning on the device, the hot side will heat quickly, the cold side will cool quickly. If you do not remove the heat from the hot side (with a heat sink or other device), the Peltier will quickly reach stasis and do nothing. We recommend using an old computer CPU heatsink or another block of metal to pull heat from the hot side. We were able to use a computer power supply and CPU heatsink to make the cold side so uncomfortable we could not hold our finger to it.

A thermoelectric cooling (TEC) module is a semiconductor-based electronic component that functions as a small heat pump. By applying the DC power source to a TEC, heat will be transferred from one side of the module to the other. It creates a cold and hot side. They are widely used in industrial areas, for example, computer CPUs, CCDs, portable refrigerators, medical instruments, and so on.

microohm-866.summary: 74374 3-State Output Octal D-Type Flip-Flop IC DIP-20 Package IC Name: 74374 Package/Case: DIP-20 Operating Temperature Range: -40°C to +85°C Quiescent Current (ICC): 80 µA max

blocks.text: 74374 D type Flip Flop Chip 5V IC DIP-20

The 74374 is an integrated circuit that embodies eight independent edge-triggered D-type flip-flops within a single DIP-20 package. Each flip-flop acts as a fundamental one-bit memory cell, capturing and retaining the logical state (high or low) present at its individual data input. This design allows for the synchronous handling of an 8-bit data word, making it a compact and efficient solution for data storage and transfer in digital systems.

The fundamental operation of the chip is governed by a shared clock signal. The data presented at the inputs is not transferred to the outputs immediately. Instead, the capture occurs precisely at the moment the clock signal transitions from a low to a high voltage level, a mechanism known as positive-edge triggering. This synchronous operation ensures that all eight bits are latched simultaneously, preventing data instability and ensuring coherent system timing.

A key feature of the 74374 is its output control capability via a dedicated Output Enable pin. When this pin is activated, the outputs behave normally, driving the stored data onto the connected bus or lines. When it is deactivated, all eight outputs enter a high-impedance state. This effectively disconnects the chip from the circuit, allowing multiple devices to share the same bus lines without electrical conflict, which is essential for building bidirectional data paths and complex bus architectures.

blocks.text: This is a XL4005 DC-DC 5-32V Adjustable Step Down 5A Buck Power Supply Module.
This module features the adjustable XL4005 step-down (buck) switching regulator, capable of driving a 5A load with excellent line and load regulation.

This XL4005 DC-DC 5-32V Adjustable Step Down 5A Buck Power Supply Module has a multi-turn trim pot (potentiometer) that you can use to adjust the output voltage. Since the trim pot has 25 turns of adjustment you can easily adjust the output of the module to exactly the voltage you need.

The simplest way to reduce the voltage of a DC supply voltage is to use a linear voltage regulator (LDO), but linear regulators step down voltage by dissipating the excess energy as heat and do not yield any current step up. Buck converters, on the other hand, can be remarkably efficient and provide a step up in current output. Buck converters are one of the best ways to provide a regulated voltage from a battery since they don’t waste near as much energy in the process of dropping the input voltage as a linear regulator would waste.

blocks.text: You want to make a cool robot, maybe a hexapod walker, or maybe just a piece of art with a lot of moving parts. Or maybe you want to drive a lot of LEDs with precise PWM output. blocks.text: Heat Shrink Tube Kit 2:1 Red and Black – 127 Pieces

The Heat Shrink Tube Kit 2:1 Red and Black – 127 Pieces is a practical and well-organized insulation assortment designed for everyday electrical and electronic work. It provides a useful selection of pre-cut heat shrink tubing in two essential colors, red and black, which are commonly used for polarity marking, cable identification, battery wiring, and general connection protection.

Made from material, the tubing is suitable for insulating exposed conductors, protecting soldered joints, reinforcing wire ends, and improving the finish of cable assemblies. Each tube features a 2:1 shrink ratio, meaning it shrinks down to approximately half of its original diameter when heated. This allows the tubing to fit more securely around wires, terminals, joints, and small cable bundles.

This kit is especially useful for technicians, electronics hobbyists, model builders, repair users, and anyone who regularly works with low-voltage wiring or general electrical maintenance. The included assortment of sizes supports a wide range of applications, from thin wires used in electronics and signal circuits to larger cable sections that require additional insulation and strain relief.

Because the kit is supplied in red and black only, it is particularly suitable for projects where positive and negative identification is important, such as battery connections, DC wiring, automotive systems, and power distribution lines. The tubes are also useful for creating cleaner-looking cable layouts and more professional finishing in repair or installation jobs.

Whether used in electronics workshops, automotive maintenance, home repairs, or hobbyist projects, this 127-piece heat shrink tube kit offers a reliable and convenient solution for insulation, protection, and cable management.

يُعد طقم الشرنك الحراري 127 قطعة من المنتجات العملية والمهمة لكل من يعمل في مجالات الكهرباء والإلكترونيات والصيانة، حيث يوفر مجموعة مرتبة من أنابيب الانكماش الحراري بأكثر لونين استخدامًا في التوصيلات الكهربائية، وهما الأحمر والأسود. وهذا يجعله مناسبًا جدًا للأعمال التي تحتاج إلى تمييز واضح بين الخط الموجب والخط السالب، أو تنظيم التوصيلات بطريقة أسهل وأكثر احترافية.

تم تصنيع الأنابيب من مادة ، وهي مادة معروفة باستخدامها في تطبيقات العزل والحماية، حيث تساعد على تغطية الأجزاء المكشوفة من الأسلاك، وحماية نقاط اللحام، وتدعيم أطراف الأسلاك، وتحسين الشكل النهائي للكابلات والتوصيلات. وتتميز الأنابيب بنسبة انكماش 2 إلى 1، أي أنها تنكمش إلى ما يقارب نصف قطرها الأصلي عند تعريضها للحرارة المناسبة، مما يساعدها على الالتفاف بإحكام حول السلك أو الجزء المراد تغطيته.

يوفر هذا الطقم مجموعة متنوعة من المقاسات التي تناسب استخدامات متعددة، بداية من الأسلاك الرفيعة المستخدمة في الدوائر الإلكترونية والمشاريع الصغيرة، وحتى المقاسات الأكبر المناسبة للكابلات أو الوصلات التي تحتاج إلى حماية إضافية. كما أن وجود اللونين الأحمر والأسود فقط يمنح هذا الطقم ميزة مهمة في التطبيقات التي تعتمد على تمييز القطبية مثل توصيلات البطاريات، وخطوط التيار المستمر، وتوصيلات السيارات، وأنظمة الطاقة المختلفة.

الأنابيب الموجودة داخل هذه المجموعة مقصوصة مسبقًا، ما يوفر الوقت أثناء العمل ويسهّل اختيار القطعة المناسبة مباشرة دون الحاجة إلى تجهيز أولي كبير. ويمكن كذلك قصها بسهولة باستخدام مقص أو أداة حادة إذا لزم الأمر.

سواء كنت تعمل في ورشة إلكترونيات، أو في صيانة السيارات، أو في مشاريع الهواة، أو في أعمال الإصلاح المنزلية، فإن هذا الطقم المكون من 127 قطعة يقدم حلًا عمليًا ومرتبًا لعزل الأسلاك وحمايتها وتنظيمها بشكل أفضل.

blocks.text: The Lishen LR1865SS is a cylindrical 18650 lithium-ion cell engineered for robust daily-use packs and precision electronics. With a nominal capacity of 3000 mAh (min. 2900 mAh at 0.2C), average working voltage 3.65 V, and maximum charge voltage 4.20 V ± 0.03 V, it balances energy density and dependable cycle life for applications like LED flashlights, power tools, UPS buffers, e-mobility packs, and DIY battery modules.
✅ Real 3000 mAh performance: Rated 3000 mAh (min 2900 mAh) at 0.2C to 2.5 V end voltage—credible energy in the 48 g class.
⚙️ Flexible charging: Standard CC-CV at 0.2C (600 mA) to 4.2 V; terminate at 0.02C (~60 mA); temperature-based charge-current limits for longevity.
🔥 Solid discharge capability: Up to 2C (6000 mA) continuous in 20–45 °C, with defined limits outside that range for safety and life.
🧪 500-cycle durability: ≥70% of first-cycle capacity after 500 cycles at 25 °C (4.2–2.5 V window).
🧲 Low impedance: Initial ≤35 mΩ for crisp voltage under load and efficient fast charging.
📏 Drop-in 18650 size: Ø 18.4 ± 0.2 mm × 65.4 ± 0.2 mm, easy fit for holders and packs.
🛡️ Safety-proven: Passed short-circuit, over-charge, heating (130 °C), over-discharge, crush and drop tests—no fire, no explosion criteria.
🧰 Builder-friendly: Manufacturer-recommended pack protections (OVP/UVP/OCP/OTP, balancing) and storage windows are clearly defined for reliable integration.
(applications per product media and pack-use guidance)
From the provided charger photos (LiitoKala Lii-500), sample cells measured ~3030–3173 mAh on capacity test modes—consistent with the 3000 mAh class rating .

blocks.text: ✅ Rate capability: At 25 °C, capacity remains ≥95% at 0.5C, ≥93% at 1C, ≥90% at 2C vs 0.2C baseline (Table 1).
🌡️ Temperature behavior: Relative capacity ≥80% at 0 °C, ≥70% at −10 °C, ≥95% at 45 °C, ≥90% at 55 °C, normalized to 25 °C (Table 2).
🔄 Storage recovery: After 28 days at 25 °C or 7 days at 55 °C, 2nd-cycle recovery ≥90% of initial capacity.
🛡️ Include BMS with OVP (<4.23 V/cell), UVP (~2.5 V), OCP (~2C), short-circuit and over-temperature protections; add balancing and thermal propagation mitigation for multi-cell packs.
🧷 Use spot-welded nickel tabs—do not solder directly to the cell to avoid seal/gasket damage.
🧮 Group cells by similar voltage/impedance (≤30 mV, ≤6 mΩ spread) for series/parallel builds.
📦 Ship/store at 25–35% SOC in low humidity; avoid vibration, impact, solarization and wetting.
🚫 No exposure to fire/water/70 °C+ environments; no reverse-polarity, nail/hammer abuse, or direct AC connection.
👶 Keep away from children; do not mix with different chemistry/capacity brands in one pack.
🧯 If electrolyte contacts eyes/skin, flush with water and seek medical help; charge/discharge away from flammables.

LEDs for status/mode/relay, jumper‑selectable serial routing. ريلاي واي فاي ESP‑01 بجهد 12 فولت وقناة واحدة —وضع AP مباشر ووضع الراوتر، إعداد عبر أندرويد، تصحيح UART، وريلاي 10A (SRD‑12VDC‑SL‑C). لمبات حالة/وضع/ريلاي وجمبرز لتوجيه التسلسلي.

blocks.text: ESP8266 ESP‑01 12V 1‑Channel Wi‑Fi Relay Module (Dual Button) | وحدة تتابع واي فاي 12 فولت قناة واحدة (زِران)

This 12V single‑channel Wi‑Fi Relay Module combines an ESP‑01 (ESP8266) Wi‑Fi module with an STM8S103 microcontroller to deliver reliable wireless control of a 10A relay for smart‑home and workshop automation. The board exposes two operating modes (AP/direct and STA/router), two push buttons (S1 Mode switch, S2 Factory reset), rich LED indicators (status, mode, relay state), and screw terminals for safe mains/low‑voltage switching (COM/NO/NC). For developers, it retains UART (TX/RX) for ESP‑01 debugging and SWIM/NRST pads for STM8 programming. In open space the direct AP link reaches up to ~100 m, while router mode depends on the access‑point signal. The relay is the well‑known SRD‑12VDC‑SL‑C (10A@250VAC / 10A@30VDC). Android phones are supported for SmartConfig provisioning. When the ESP‑01 is unplugged, the board can act as a USB/TTL‑driven relay via the MCU (as a local/bench relay).

تجمع هذه الوحدة ذات القناة الواحدة بجهد 12 فولت بين وحدة ESP‑01 (ESP8266) للاتصال اللاسلكي ومعالج STM8S103 لتوفير تحكم موثوق في ريلاي 10 أمبير لأتمتة المنزل والورشة. تتضمن اللوحة وضعين للتشغيل (وضع نقطة الوصول المباشر AP، ووضع الراوتر STA)، وزرّين (S1 لتبديل الوضع، S2 لإرجاع المصنع)، ومجموعة لمبات بيان (حالة التشغيل، وضع العمل، حالة الريلاي)، وأطراف لولبية آمنة للتوصيل (COM/NO/NC). للمطورين، تتوافر واجهة UART (TX/RX) لتصحيح ESP‑01 ووسادات SWIM/NRST لبرمجة STM8. في بيئة مفتوحة قد يصل مدى الربط المباشر إلى ~100 متر، بينما يعتمد وضع الراوتر على قوة إشارة نقطة الوصول. الريلاي المستخدم هو SRD‑12VDC‑SL‑C الشائع (10A عند 250VAC أو 30VDC). يدعم إعداد الشبكة عبر Android/SmartConfig. وعند نزع ESP‑01 يمكن استخدام اللوحة كريلاي USB/TTL عبر المتحكم.
📶 ESP8266 Wi‑Fi + STM8 MCU: mature 8‑bit control plus popular Wi‑Fi stack.
🔌 10A Relay (SRD‑12VDC‑SL‑C): switch AC loads up to 250VAC/10A or DC up to 30V/10A.

blocks.text: The 2UUL SC11 EcoFlux Flux Paste is a workshop-friendly flux paste formulated for electronics soldering and rework. Use it to improve wetting, speed up joint formation, and make challenging connections—fine-pitch IC pins, oxidized pads, shield tabs, and wire terminations—behave predictably during both leaded and lead-free work. Its paste form lets you place a controlled amount exactly where you need it for consistent results.
✅ Stronger wetting, faster joints — helps solder flow onto pads, vias, and component leads with fewer retries.
🔧 Great for SMD rework — supports drag-soldering, bridge cleanup with braid, and pad touch-ups on fine-pitch parts.
🧑‍🏭 Precise placement — paste consistency stays where you apply it, reducing mess around dense footprints.
🧽 Easier cleanup — residues can be cleaned using your standard board-safe solvent routine if required by your process.
🧰 Everyday versatility — useful for wire tinning, connector shells, ground pours, and stubborn pads.
✅ Drag-soldering QFP/QFN/TSSOP lead rows with a knife or chisel tip.
✅ Bridge removal using copper braid: flux the bridge, lay braid, apply heat, lift straight up.
✅ Pad preparation on oxidized or aged boards before placing new parts.
✅ Wire & header work where quick wetting avoids prolonged heat on plastics.
✅ Shield cans & ground tabs that require extra activation along large copper areas.
✅ Thin film, not a blob — a light coating often outperforms heavy application.
✅ Pre-tin the iron — keep a small solder bead on the tip; re-tin frequently for consistent heat transfer.
✅ Let the flux do the work — if a joint resists, add a touch of flux and re-approach rather than increasing force.
✅ Use braid correctly — press the braid and tip together on the joint; remove both at once to avoid wicking too much copper heat.
✅ Post-process hygiene — follow your standard cleaning/inspection routine, especially around fine-pitch pins.
🧤 Wear basic PPE — gloves/eye protection; avoid skin contact.
🌬️ Ventilation — work in a ventilated area or with fume extraction.
🔒 Storage — keep the container closed when not in use; store away from heat and direct sunlight.
🚫 Keep off hot surfaces — apply before heating; do not leave paste on hot irons or plates.
🧯 ESD awareness — maintain normal ESD precautions during rework.

blocks.text: Zener Diode 33V 0.5W DO‑35 — High‑Voltage Precision Regulator

Zener Diode 33V 0.5W DO‑35 is a robust, high-voltage regulation component designed to precisely clamp voltage at 33 volts. Packaged in a glass DO‑35 axial form, this diode is perfect for surge protection, voltage reference, and high-voltage power electronics. With reliable thermal stability and low leakage current, the Zener Diode 33V 0.5W meets the demands of both industrial and consumer-grade designs.

The Zener Diode 33V 0.5W is part of the popular BZX55C series of Zener diodes, which are widely used for voltage regulation and over-voltage protection. When connected in reverse bias, this diode holds the voltage at approximately 33 V, within a tolerance of ±5%. It provides a convenient method for protecting sensitive circuits from voltage spikes, generating stable reference voltages, or clamping signals in analog and digital circuits.
For further background on Zener diodes and their operation, refer to the detailed Wikipedia article on Zener diodes, which explains the reverse breakdown mechanism and common electronic applications.
With a nominal voltage of 33 V (±5%), the Zener Diode 33V 0.5W ensures stable voltage control suitable for analog front-ends, reference systems, or voltage clamp circuits.
Able to dissipate up to 0.5 W, this diode handles moderate current surges and is perfect for small protection circuits and voltage shunt applications.

blocks.text: This is a simple but very useful module which uses a potential divider to reduce an input voltage by a factor of 5. The Voltage Sensor Module 25V allows you to use the analog input of a microcontroller to monitor voltages much higher than it capable of sensing.
For example with a 0-5V analog input range, you are able to measure a voltage up to 25V. This voltage sensor module also includes convenient screw terminals for easy and secure connection of a wire.

This module is based on the principle of resistive voltage divider design, can make the red terminal connector input voltage to 5 times smaller. Arduino analog input voltages up to 5 v, the voltage detection module input voltage not greater than 5Vx5=25V (if using 3.3V systems, input voltage not greater than 3.3Vx5=16.5V).
Arduino AVR chips have 10-bit AD, so this module simulates a resolution of 0.00489V (5V/1023), so the minimum voltage of input voltage detection module is 0.00489Vx5=0.02445V.
Keep in mind, you are restricted to voltages that are less than 25 volts. More than that and you will exceed the voltage limit of your Arduino input.

blocks.text: L293D PowerDIP-16 Stepper Motor Controller/ Driver is a dual H-bridge motor driver integrated circuit (IC). Motor drivers act as current amplifiers since they take a low-current control signal and provide a higher-current signal. This higher current signal is used to drive the motors.

The Device is a monolithic integrated high voltage, high current four channel driver designed to accept standard DTL or TTL logic levels and drive inductive loads (such as relays solenoids, DC and stepping motors) and switching power transistors. To simplify use as two bridges each pair of channels is equipped with an enable input. A separate supply input is provided for the logic, allowing operation at a lower voltage and internal clamp diodes are included.

It is suitable for use in switching applications at frequencies up to 5 kHz. The L293D is assembled in a 16 lead plastic package which has 4 centre pins connected together and used for heatsinking The L293DD is assembled in a 20 lead surface mount which has 8 centre pins connected together and used for heatsinking.

L293D contains two inbuilt H-bridge driver circuits. In its common mode of operation, two DC motors can be driven simultaneously, both in forward and reverse direction. The motor operations of two motors can be controlled by input logic at pins 2 & 7 and 10 & 15. Input logic 00 or 11 will stop the corresponding motor. Logic 01 and 10 will rotate it in clockwise and anticlockwise directions, respectively. Enable pins 1 and 9 (corresponding to the two motors) must be high for motors to start operating.

When an enable input is high, the associated driver gets enabled. As a result, the outputs become active and work in phase with their inputs. Similarly, when the enable input is low, that driver is disabled, and their outputs are off and in the high-impedance state. They are designed to drive inductive loads such as relays, solenoids, dc and bipolar stepping motors, as well as their high-current/high-voltage loads in positive-supply applications.

blocks.text: The 7x7mm 6-Pin Self-Locking PCB Push Button Switch is a small, practical, and reliable push button switch designed for electronic circuits that require a maintained ON-OFF switching action. This switch is commonly used in printed circuit board applications where the user needs a compact mechanical button that can keep its state after being pressed.

Unlike momentary push buttons that only work while being pressed, this self-locking switch uses a latching mechanism. Press the button once and the switch changes state. Press it again and it returns to the previous state. This makes it suitable for ON-OFF control, function selection, mode switching, enable/disable inputs, signal routing, and many other control applications in compact electronic devices.

The switch comes in a compact square body with a 7x7mm class footprint and 6 through-hole terminals. The 6-pin structure allows it to be used in circuits that require stable switching between contact states, depending on the PCB design and wiring layout. It is commonly used as a PCB-mounted self-lock push button in DIY electronics, consumer electronic devices, audio circuits, control modules, repair work, educational projects, and prototype boards.

This product is useful when a small mechanical ON-OFF switch is required directly on the PCB instead of using a larger panel-mounted switch. Its small size helps save board space, while the through-hole terminals provide strong mechanical support after soldering. The switch is also suitable for repeated operation, with a long expected mechanical lifespan for normal control applications.

The switch is designed for low-current electronic circuits. It may be used for direct switching in suitable low-power applications, but for motors, lamps, heaters, high-current loads, or circuits with high inrush current, it is recommended to use this switch as a control signal input for a relay, transistor driver, logic circuit, or power switching module.
This product is a self-locking / latching push button switch. It is not a momentary switch.

مفتاح الضغط الذاتي التثبيت مقاس 7 × 7 مللي بستة أطراف هو مفتاح صغير مخصص للتركيب المباشر على البوردة الإلكترونية، ويستخدم في الدوائر التي تحتاج إلى وظيفة تشغيل وفصل ثابتة داخل مساحة صغيرة. هذا المفتاح مناسب للمشاريع الإلكترونية، دوائر التحكم، أجهزة الإلكترونيات الصغيرة، أعمال الصيانة، وتجارب الطلاب والهواة.

هذا النوع يعمل بنظام التثبيت الذاتي، أي أنه لا يعمل فقط أثناء الضغط مثل المفاتيح اللحظية، بل يغير حالته مع كل ضغطة. عند الضغط مرة يتم تثبيت حالة التوصيل، وعند الضغط مرة أخرى يعود إلى الحالة السابقة. لذلك فهو مناسب جدًا للتطبيقات التي تحتاج إلى زر تشغيل وفصل صغير على البوردة نفسها.

يتميز المفتاح بجسم مربع صغير، وزر ضغط علوي، وستة أطراف مخصصة للحام المباشر على اللوحة الإلكترونية. تصميم الأطراف الستة يمنحه مرونة في التوصيل حسب تصميم الدائرة ومسارات البوردة، كما يساعد التثبيت من خلال الثقوب على إعطاء ثبات ميكانيكي جيد بعد اللحام.

يمكن استخدام هذا المفتاح في اختيار أوضاع التشغيل، تشغيل وفصل دوائر منخفضة التيار، التحكم في الإشارات، تفعيل أو تعطيل وظيفة معينة، أو استخدامه كبديل صغير للمفاتيح الأكبر في الأجهزة التي لا تسمح بمساحة كبيرة. كما أنه مناسب جدًا لدوائر التجارب والنماذج الأولية وأعمال الإصلاح.

هذا المنتج مخصص أساسًا لدوائر التحكم منخفضة التيار. لذلك لا يفضل استخدامه مباشرة مع الأحمال العالية أو المحركات أو السخانات أو أي حمل يسحب تيارًا كبيرًا. في هذه الحالات، الأفضل استخدام المفتاح كإشارة تحكم لريلاي أو دائرة قيادة مناسبة.
هذا المنتج هو مفتاح ضغط ذاتي التثبيت وليس مفتاحًا لحظيًا.

BTT UPS 24V V1.0 is an external module of the 3D printer with the function of power off resume print, which was launched by the 3D printing team of Shenzhen Big Tree Technology CO., LTD. It is applicable to all 3D printers powered by DC24V switch power, such as Ender 3 printer.
Adopt voltage comparator LM393 chip, which can detect power failure sensitively

Equipped with 9 2.7V 5F supercapacitors to store electricity, so that there is sufficient power supply after detecting the power failure, then the printer can successfully complete the corresponding operation
An anti-reverse protection circuit is added at the power interface to prevent irreversible damage caused by the reverse power supply, which greatly protects the circuit board
The module is small and easy to install
Main function: realize the power off resume print function
Support model：All DC24V powered 3D printers are available（like Ender3）
